LESSON: ATTENTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 1.1: Attentive listening

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Attentive listening. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Attentive listening and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Attentive listening with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Attentive listening.
2. Explain Attentive listening to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Attentive listening.
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Attentive listening. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Attentive listening important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Attentive listening is important in everyday life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
